caveat: Census 2021 is a single cross-section at the reference date. The gender identity question was NEW in 2021 and voluntary, asked only of usual residents aged 16 and over, so these counts cannot by themselves establish any trend: there is no comparable prior measurement. Disclosure control and record swapping are applied by ONS, so small cells are perturbed. A missing or non-normal cell is missing, never zero.
